item.description: This year’s Olympic spotlight isn’t on athletes — it’s on stoats. For the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan-Cortina, the official mascots are Tina and Milo, a pair of stoats, otherwise known in North America as short-tailed weasels (Mustela erminea), chosen to represent the Olympic and Paralympic Games.
